entities.name: APC-II pelvic injury
observations: Young–Burgess APC-II is an open-book pelvic-ring injury with pubic symphysis diastasis, anterior sacroiliac disruption, and sacrotuberous ligament disruption.
Posterior sacroiliac ligaments are preserved in the classic APC-II pattern, maintaining vertical stability while rotational instability is present.
Sacrotuberous and sacrospinous disruption is conventional, but MRI evidence indicates sacrospinous injury is variable in actual APC-II cases.

entities.name: APC-II classic ligament pattern
observations: The defining multiple-choice pattern is pubic symphysis diastasis, torn anterior sacroiliac ligaments, torn sacrotuberous ligament, and intact posterior sacroiliac ligaments.
